frequency_question: How often does the central bank successfully execute the end-to-end notification and operational rollout of an incremental reserve requirement ratio within a rolling four-month window when conditions dictate?
membership_rule: Includes any formal announcement and operationalization of incremental cash reserve ratios or equivalent temporary liquidity impounding measures by the central bank. Excludes standard annual or scheduled routine bi-weekly CRR maintenance adjustments.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 1 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 1 named; constitutes the sole direct historical precedent for the specific 'iCRR' nomenclature, though broader liquidity absorption tools have precedent.
known_gaps: Prior to 2023, similar ad-hoc liquidity measures were termed differently (e.g., ad-hoc CRR hikes), but the administrative pipeline remains identical.
skeleton: Total policy review cycles requiring liquidity absorption of similar magnitude since 2004, decomposed into internal deliberation (10 days), technical system reconfiguration across commercial banks (14 days), and final gazette/notification publication (2 days).
multiplier: 1 observed deployment / 1 necessary liquidity shock event requiring this specific operational tool within the modern regulatory framework.
